FILE 01 // CASE BRIEFING
CASE BRIEFING // INCIDENT: UNLAWFUL DATA EXTRACTION
DATE: TODAY | TIME OF DISCOVERY: 04:15 AM
LOCATION UNDER INVESTIGATION: ARCHIVE VAULT (SUB-BASEMENT 01)
----------------------------------------------------
SUMMARY:
At 04:15 AM, the automated monitoring system reported
unauthorized physical terminal access inside the ARCHIVE
VAULT. The core neural weights were partially cloned to
a local hardware partition.

FACILITY TOPOLOGY:
- Sub-Basement Archive Vault has exactly ONE entrance,
  protected by an RFID Reader.
- The Vault is isolated from campus Wi-Fi; extraction
  requires physical console access.
- Security Camera CAM-04 monitors the corridor outside
  the Vault door.
- Turnstiles at the Main Lab Gate and Cafeteria log all
  badge movements.

YOUR TASK:
Analyze the enclosed timeline, RFID swipe records, lab
sign-out ledgers, and suspect statements to determine WHO
breached the vault, at what exact TIME, HOW they gained
entry, and WHICH terminal bay was compromised.

DR. V. ARYA — Project Lead (CARD-104)
Statement: "I was not on campus. I left at 10:00 PM for an industry conference. My primary keycard was locked in my desk drawer in Room 302."
Alibi check: Toll plaza ANPR confirms his vehicle crossed the interstate toll at 10:48 PM. His desk drawer was found pried open.
A. SEN — Research Assistant (CARD-209)
Profile: Wears a cyan PulseFit Neo tracker. Signed out lab equipment yesterday.
Statement: "I never came near the lab after 08:00 PM. I went straight to my off-campus flat and slept until 07:00 AM."
Evidence contradiction: pending verification.
R. SHARMA — DevOps Intern (CARD-312)
Profile: Wears a classic analog metal chronograph watch.
Statement: "I was running automated stress tests in Server Room B between 03:30 AM and 04:30 AM."
Alibi check: verified by badge telemetry at 03:42 AM and 04:01 AM, corroborated by terminal logs.
M. KHAN — Night Shift Security Officer (GUARD-01)
Statement: "I performed physical rounds on the Ground Floor and Floor 1 between 03:30 AM and 04:15 AM. Sub-basement was locked per night protocol."
Alibi check: patrol key-turn stations validated at 03:38, 03:51, and 04:05 AM.

hints.text: Cross-reference the wrist accessory visible on CCTV (03:54:30 AM) with the suspect profiles in File 04.
Notice who checked out an unreturned cloning tool in File 03 and check when CARD-104 swiped the Archive Vault door.
